parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID of the instance to which the network interface controller (NIC) is attached.

parameters.name: Ipv6Address
parameters.description: The IPv6 address of the network interface controller (NIC). N indicates that you can specify multiple IPv6 addresses. Valid values of N: 1 to 100.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description:
The maximum number of entries per page for paging. Valid values: 10 to 500.

Default value:

- If you do not set this parameter or set it to a value less than 10, the default value is 10.
- If you set this parameter to a value greater than 500, the default value is 500.

parameters.name: NetworkInterfaceId
parameters.description: The network interface controller (NIC) ID. Valid values of N: 1 to 100.

parameters.name: NetworkInterfaceName
parameters.description: The name of the network interface controller (NIC). The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length and can contain characters from the Unicode letter categorization (which includes English letters, Chinese characters, and digits). The name can contain colons (:), underscores (_), periods (.), or hyphens (-).

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description:
The pagination token. Set this parameter to the `NextToken` value returned in the previous API call.

For information about how to view the returned data, refer to the operation description above.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: > This parameter is deprecated. Use the MaxResults and NextToken parameters for pagination.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: > This parameter is deprecated. Use the MaxResults and NextToken parameters for pagination.

parameters.name: PrimaryIpAddress
parameters.description: The primary private IP address of the network interface controller (NIC).

parameters.name: PrivateIpAddress
parameters.description: The secondary private IP address of the network interface controller (NIC). Valid values of N: 1 to 100.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) to query the most recent region list.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description:
The resource group ID. If you use this parameter to filter resources, the resource count cannot exceed 1,000.

>Filtering by the default resource group is not supported.

parameters.name: SecurityGroupId
parameters.description:
The security group ID of the secondary ENI.

- To query information about a secondary ENI by security group ID, specify this parameter.
- To query information about a primary ENI by security group ID, call [DescribeInstances](~~25506~~) and specify the `SecurityGroupId` parameter.

parameters.name: ServiceManaged
parameters.description: Indicates whether the user of the network interface controller (NIC) is an Alibaba Cloud service or a Virtual Network Operator (VNO).

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The status of the network interface controller (NIC). Valid values:

* Available: available.
* Attaching: being attached.
* InUse: attached.
* Detaching: being detached.
* Deleting: being deleted.

Default value: null, which indicates that all statuses are queried.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description: The tag key of the network interface controller (NIC). Valid values of N: 1 to 20.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description:
The tag value of the network interface controller (NIC). Valid values of N: 1 to 20.

If you use a single tag to filter resources, the resource count with the specified tag cannot exceed 1,000. If you use multiple tags to filter resources, the resource count of resources that are attached to all specified tags cannot exceed 1,000. If the resource count exceeds 1,000, call the [ListTagResources](~~110425~~) operation to query the resources.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description:
The type of the Elastic Network Interface (ENI). Valid values:

- Primary: primary network interface controller (NIC).
- Secondary: secondary ENI.

Default value: null, which indicates that all types are queried.

parameters.name: VSwitchId
parameters.description: The vSwitch ID of the network interface controller (NIC).

parameters.name: VpcId
parameters.description: The virtual private cloud (VPC) ID of the network interface controller (NIC).
